name: Panghuang Zhi Jie
source:
The world seems to be back on track, and the entire city is under the control of my parents' Baishi Group.
As their daughter, I am no exception.
I do everything according to their will, and the ultimate goal is to become the successor of their business empire.
But this is not the life I want.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1672670/]Steam[/url]]
